title: 还在数拍
brief: One silver sailor-uniform girl, one simple mechanical metronome on desk to her right, long dark swinging pointer. Eyes count time, slower blinking, nodding along turns into a doze; metronome keeps ticking as her forehead sinks onto folded arms, a startle raises her to resume counting.

board.title: 还在数拍
poses: 0.0 s: Draw the silver-haired sailor-uniform girl upright at the desk, eyes tracking left; cross her forearms with both hands exposed beside opposite elbows, and place the metronome to her right with its long dark pointer tilted left.
0.6 s: Draw the full scene with her chin dipping in time, eyes tracking right and eyelids lowering; keep her folded arms still and swing the pointer right.
1.2 s: Draw her nodding lower through a slow, closed-eye blink; preserve both visible hands and swing the pointer left.
1.8 s: Draw her reopening heavy eyelids toward the rightward pointer, shoulders drooping and chin sinking closer to her folded arms.
2.4 s: Draw her eyes closing again as her forehead nearly reaches her forearms; keep both hands exposed and the pointer tilted left.
3.0 s: Draw her asleep with forehead resting on the middle of her folded forearms, hair settling forward and both hands visible outside; swing the pointer right.
3.6 s: Draw a sudden startle with her forehead lifting, eyes opening wide and shoulders jerking upward; keep both forearms planted and swing the pointer left.
4.2 s: Draw her upright again, eyes following the rightward pointer and lips forming a small counting shape; retain the same crossed arms and visible hands.
4.6 s: Draw her shoulders settling, chin slightly raised and eyes following the pointer as it travels left through center, ready to ease into the opening pose.
board.continuity: Use one fixed camera and identical full-scene framing throughout the 4.8-second loop, preserving the girl, exposed hands and stationary metronome base while its pointer ticks continuously and pose nine eases into the distinct opening pose.
